 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    R, C = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Identify rectangular U-shaped figures: vertical sides and bottom, with a
    # one-cell opening in the top edge. Fill their interior and extend the
    # opening leftward on the row immediately above.
    seen = set()
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if grid[r][c] != 5 or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = []
            stack = [(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c))
            while stack:
                y,x = stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=p[0]<R and 0<=p[1]<C and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==5 and p not in seen:
                        seen.add(p); stack.append(p)
            y0=min(y for y,x in cells); y1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            x0=min(x for y,x in cells); x1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            # Recognize the frame pattern (left/right walls, bottom, top gap).
            if y1-y0 < 2 or x1-x0 < 2: continue
            if not all(grid[y][x0]==5 and grid[y][x1]==5 for y in range(y0,y1+1)): continue
            if not all(grid[y1][x]==5 for x in range(x0,x1+1)): continue
            gaps=[x for x in range(x0,x1+1) if grid[y0][x]==0]
            if len(gaps)!=1: continue
            for y in range(y0+1,y1):
                for x in range(x0+1,x1): out[y][x]=2
            out[y0][gaps[0]]=2
            for x in range(gaps[0]): out[y0-1][x]=2
    return out
